company.name: Hoods
company.shortDescription: Hoods is a live social networking platform focused on location-based community interaction and real-time engagement.
company.description: Hoods is a social networking platform that enables users to interact through location-based communities and live digital experiences. The platform combines real-time communication, user-generated content, and community engagement features to support local discovery and online interaction. It is designed for individuals and groups to connect around shared interests, events, and neighborhood activities through mobile and web-based access.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $24,886, or 5.54% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,910,662 to $497,712, a 0.26x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 83 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
